scientific_question: What is the smallest exponent-preserving ambient-momentum format that retains the successful FP16 Pair-VQ Muon polar field at both early and terminal 124M states?

low_bit_rejection.finding: Uniform block int4 plus a ternary residual preserves ordinary vector cosine but catastrophically rotates the nonlinear Muon polar factor. Another bit or block-size sweep in that family is forbidden.

non_scientific_performance_pilot.role: The preflight is not scientific evidence. Its step-1/step-9 observer outputs motivated, but do not satisfy, the confirmatory early-futility rule below.

theory.mechanism: Muon uses a polar-like map. For H=U Sigma V^T, first-order singular-frame perturbations contain denominators sigma_i+sigma_j. Coarse absolute quantization disproportionately corrupts small singular directions even when Frobenius cosine is high.
theory.deduction: FP16 succeeds while same-byte BF16 and uniform int4 fail. The discriminating property is not merely byte count; it is FP16's five-bit exponent field plus progressively finer relative mantissa resolution. The next nested family must therefore preserve FP16 exponent/range exactly and truncate only significand bits.
theory.nested_test_value: E5M2, E5M4, E5M6, E5M8, and the E5M10 FP16 control form one nested hypothesis test. A single audit identifies whether polar fidelity has a precision threshold without changing coordinate topology, block scales, or the working forward representation.
non_claims: Passing this audit does not establish language-model loss parity.
The simulated formats are not a claim of immediate hardware acceleration.
The audit does not authorize changing Pair-VQ weights, attention, learning rate, horizon, or model width.

frozen_representation.forward_weight: Keep the successful Pair-VQ base and fractional_lattice_q7q8_b32_p25_rq4_cfcq5b64l16 feedback representation bit-identical.
frozen_representation.attention: Keep the successful QK-only BlockFHT attention parent bit-identical.
frozen_representation.optimizer_request: For each MLP matrix, decode the candidate history, form B_next=round_candidate(mu*B_previous+G), form H=G+mu*decode(B_next), and apply the exact production Newton-Schulz Muon map.
frozen_representation.reference: Use the successful production FP16 recurrence as the reference, including FP16 rounding after every momentum update. No FP32 hidden residual or master momentum is permitted in a candidate.
forbidden_changes: Pair-VQ codebooks, codes, feedback codec, levels, blocks, or Lloyd iterations
learning rate, schedule, seed, data order, horizon, or Muon Newton-Schulz steps
blockwise scales, stochastic rounding, error feedback, dense residuals, or rank correction
language-model endpoint, width scale-up, horizon transfer, or parameter sweep

formats.encoding: Use the IEEE FP16 sign and five-bit exponent exactly. For a finite FP16 value, round its ten stored fraction bits to the registered retained mantissa width using deterministic round-to-nearest, ties-to-even, with carry into the unchanged FP16 exponent field. Preserve signed zero, subnormal semantics, saturation, and finite values; reject any non-finite input or output.
formats.packing: The audit may simulate with uint16 storage, but selection and byte accounting use an explicit tightly packed sign+exponent+mantissa bitstream with no per-block scale or padding except final-byte padding.
formats.nestedness_invariant: Every coarser decoded value must equal applying its own deterministic mask/rounding rule directly to the same FP16 source; no candidate-specific calibration is allowed.

stage_ab_deterministic_replay.method: Replay the exact successful 238-update FP16-owner config from its registered seed and data stream. Candidate histories remain nonintervening. Probe early updates 0 and 8 and terminal update 237 in one run; require the production-owner terminal fixed-eval CE to reproduce the sealed endpoint within 0.002. This avoids bypassing exact-resume source/config identity merely to attach an observer.
stage_ab_deterministic_replay.early_futility_rule: After an independently launched registered nine-update replay, stop the family if the FP16 control passes and no compressed candidate passes every frozen direction threshold at both early probes. Continue to terminal update 237 only if at least one compressed candidate passes both early probes.

measurements: momentum-state relative error, cosine, and positive-line energy recovery
combined pre-polar request relative error, cosine, and positive-line energy recovery
post-polar Muon update relative error, cosine, and positive-line energy recovery
all/c_fc/c_proj energy-weighted aggregates and every-matrix minima
finite-value, signed-zero, subnormal, saturation, and nested-rounding invariants
simulated bytes, theoretical packed bytes, and encode/decode wall time

decision_gate.selection: Choose the smallest total-bit candidate that passes all early and terminal deterministic-replay requirements. Resolve ties by the larger minimum every-matrix post-polar cosine.
decision_gate.early_futility: If the registered step-1/step-9 gate has a passing FP16 control and zero passing compressed candidates, classify the mantissa-only family as rejected without a terminal replay. This is valid because every-probe success is a necessary condition of the frozen terminal selection rule.
decision_gate.if_pass: Authorize only an implementation-quality packed-state prototype with exact recurrence/checkpoint tests and an exact-config >=20% MFU gate. No LM endpoint is automatically authorized.
decision_gate.if_fail: Reject mantissa-only truncation as the next compression family. Derive a singular-direction-aware correction or factored polar-history representation before any further LM endpoint.

execution_policy.monitoring: Attach one persistent terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog immediately after launch; this diagnostic has no scientifically actionable intermediate milestone.
execution_policy.launch_precondition: PRO6 nvidia-smi, CUDA allocation, and native extension must be healthy. Do not launch while the post-power-cycle NVIDIA driver/library mismatch persists.
